name: BACH_0053
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (96%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class set and 5/5 similar cases agree, but MUSK disagrees.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 96%, InSitu 3%, Normal 1% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | Benign only | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 98th pct | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Disagrees | Conflicting second opinion |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign | Full agreement |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Score low; pulls away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 3) · ↓ invasive · High score; lowers invasive association [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 0, 4, 11) · context · 59% neoplastic nuclei; above 92% of reference images [F7] · Measured
- **Nuclear shape variation** (regions 0, 4, 11) · context · Top of reference range [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect classifier; mitoses (0/20) Unreliable [F3].

## Could be wrong if
- Tumor fraction and nuclear shape variation are high in sampled regions, against the benign call.
- MUSK picks a different top class, so the call is not independently confirmed.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 4**: confirm "neoplastic" nuclei (25, 47 counted) are malignant, not benign epithelium.
2. **Regions 2, 3**: check for gland or tubule architecture supporting the benign suggestion.
3. **Region 5**: highest duct-confined score, Weak (12/20); rule out in situ.
